The provider is Energy, Water Services and Municipal Waste Management Services Regulatory Commission. Coverage: Coverage is North Macedonia in 2024; the report was submitted in April 2025. Individual figures may compare earlier years or distinguish regulated service populations. Access: The official PDF was opened through the web reader. Scope, source statement and usage terms were read; individual tables were not systematically extracted. Licence and cost: The report explicitly permits use of its data with a full citation to the 2024 ERC annual report. Limitations: The report combines market-monitoring and submitted information. Each indicator’s definition and reporting boundary need checking before comparison. For simulation it supplies national operating, regulatory and service-performance evidence. Related resources: MEPSO’s 2021–2030 plan is a separate forward-planning source; this report describes the 2024 reporting period.
